note: Correct but unconventional: twice the time to the top instead of the full-flight equation.
problem: A ball is kicked at 20 m/s at 30° above the horizontal on level ground. How long is it in the air? (g = 9.81 m/s²)

attempt.text:
v_y = 20 sin 30° = 10 m/s
At the top v_y = 0, so t_up = 10/9.81 = 1.02 s
Level ground, so coming down takes the same time
t = 2 × 1.02 = 2.04 s
